name: caveman
title_zh: 省七成 token 的穴居人语，技术精度不掉分毫
tagline_zh: 长回复烧 token 烧到肉疼？切穴居人模式，同一套技术结论用 1/4 字数讲完。
tagline_en: Long replies burning tokens? Flip caveman mode—same technical verdict in a quarter of the words. Six levels, lite.
desc_en: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Cuts token usage ~75% by speaking like caveman while keeping full technical accuracy. Supports intensity levels: lite, full (default), ultra, wenyan-lite, wenyan-full, wenyan-ultra. Use when user says "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "use caveman", "less tokens", "be brief", or invokes /caveman. Also auto-triggers when token efficiency is requested.
why_zh: 不是简单缩写，是按穴居人语法重构句子，保留所有术语和数字，只砍连接词和客套。技术文档照读。
why_en: Not mere abbreviation—it re-syntaxes sentences to caveman grammar, keeping every term and number while stripping connectors and.
limit_zh: 只对英文输出生效，中文回复不压缩。默认 full 档会砍掉礼貌用语，若下游要直接贴给客户需先切 lite。
limit_en: English output only; Chinese untouched. Full level strips politeness—switch to lite before pasting to clients. Wenyan levels restyle, don't save.
title_en: Caveman talk, 75% fewer tokens, full technical accuracy
